description: What a repository's share holds (docs/design/identity-synced-state.md §5): forge-core ShareRule::of and forge-web shareRule over the same synced storage slot entries ({at, v}; v null is a tombstone; entries null means the slot is absent or unreadable). Only the repository's own repo:<repoId> entry is ever shared; the synced default never is. No slot: keep. No live repo entry: nothing (stop sharing). A repo entry that does not parse, or names a non-Platform profile that is missing, tombstoned, of an unknown kind or invalid: keep. Platform only: nothing. A case's share, when given, is the repository's current share as its owner opens it: its format version, whether it lends storage (holds any profile), and whether any grant to it exists (grants, default false); without one there is no share. Version 2 is written only under this rule; a share kept while the slot was read that is still version 1 and lends storage may hold the default, so it stops (nothing); one that lends nothing but still has grants is a stop that was interrupted, so it stops again. With no slot read, any share is kept. expect is keep, nothing, or the shared profile names and policy targets.

cases.name: no synced storage slot keeps the share
an empty synced slot (no repository entry) stops sharing
profiles but no repository entry stop sharing
default present, no repository entry: sharing stops (the default is never shared)
a tombstoned repository entry is absent: sharing stops, the default is not used
the repository entry shares its synced profile as it is
a repository entry naming a profile that is not synced keeps the share
Platform only, built in or a platform-kind profile: sharing stops
a platform-kind profile under another name is the platform target
a repository entry that does not parse keeps the share
a named profile tombstoned keeps the share
a named profile that does not validate keeps the share
a named profile of a kind this build does not know keeps the share
replicas 0 does not parse: keep the share
replicas above 8 does not parse: keep the share
a fractional replicas does not parse: keep the share
kept while the slot was read, a version 1 share that lends storage stops (it may hold the default)
kept while the slot was read, a version 2 share is kept
kept while the slot was read, an empty version 1 share is kept (nothing to stop)
kept while the slot was read, an empty share that still has grants stops again (an interrupted stop)
no slot read: an empty share with grants is kept
no slot read: a version 1 share that lends storage is kept
a usable repository entry replaces a version 1 share
